record.label: production-branch reference; deployment unverified
record.scope: Six units declare MAGICAL_LEAF: Bulbasaur, Snivy (1 star), Ivysaur, Servine (2 stars), Venusaur, Serperior (3 stars). The strategy is shared; unit differences are star count (table index), range and passive. Snivy and Servine declare passive HATCH (not covered; the passive record is separate).
record.summary: The caster picks its farthest targettable unit (PokemonState.getFarthestTarget, strictly greater distance wins) or, if none, the cast target, and hits every unit of another team on the straight line of cells from the caster to it, both ends included. Each unit hit gets an armor-reduction status for 3000 ms (before duration reductions) and SPECIAL damage (raw 10/20/40/80 by stars). If no enemy is on the line, the cast target is hit instead.

targeting.who: units of another team on the supercover line between the caster and its farthest targettable unit; fallback: the cast target
targeting.note: Selection of the farthest target is by distanceM from the caster over all targettable units, ties resolved by board scan order (first one kept). The farthest target itself is hit only if it is on the line (it is the end of the line, so normally yes). Allies on the line are skipped by the team filter.

geometry.shape: line (supercover) from the caster's cell to the farthest target's cell, both ends included; no width, no falloff

effects.target: each unit of another team on the line (each once); else the cast target
effects.scaling: AP: damage x (1 + AP/100) (apBoost true by default); the cast's crit flag multiplies by critPower only if the cast crit (canCritByDefault is false, so needs ABILITY_CRIT); no falloff along the line
effects.resolution: then each target's SPE_DEF division and untraced modifiers; blocked entirely by protect / skydiving / magicBounce per target

effects.target: each unit hit (same set as the damage)
effects.resolution: triggerArmorReduction is applied before the damage call, so the damage of the same cast already sees the reduced SPE_DEF; the status is skipped on a target with runeProtect, its duration is passed through applyStatusDurationReductions (not read) and a longer existing cooldown is kept

statusEffects.effect: def and speDef halved (rounded) in the damage path read

starBehavior.note: indexed by the casting entity's stars (1, 2 or 3 for the listed units); the 4-star column (80) is not reachable by the bare factory star counts. Whether other mechanics raise an entity's star count was not examined.

record.positionalConditions: The set of units hit depends on the caster's and farthest target's coordinates. If the farthest target is adjacent, the line is two cells. Allies on the line are not affected. If getFarthestTarget returns nothing the cast target ends the line.
record.repeatedCastsAndModes: No stored state or modes. Each cast recomputes the farthest target and line; the status duration is not stacked (the longer cooldown is kept).
record.rawVsResolved: Declared raw: damage 10/20/40 (1/2/3 stars) per unit hit and armor reduction 3000 ms. The damage dealt is raw x (1 + AP/100), then SPE_DEF division and untraced modifiers, per target; with armor reduction active the target's SPE_DEF is halved first.
dependsOnUnverifiedGenericCombat: Final damage after handleSpecialDamage's later modifiers (SPE_DEF division, shields, items, resurrection, field multipliers)
